funder_origin_name: Wolf Foundation (endowment donated by Ricardo Subirana y Lobo Wolf and Francisca Subirana-Wolf)
funding_share_basis: 100% of the purse comes from investment income on the Wolf Foundation's endowment, which was capitalized by a single private gift of about USD 10 million from Ricardo Wolf and his wife Francisca when the Foundation began operating in 1976; no other funder contributes to the prize money, so the >50% rule is satisfied by the Foundation alone in both the origin and current states. The Israeli state supplies no purse money: its role is statutory oversight only (the Foundation was constituted under the Wolf Foundation Law-1975, the Minister of Education chairs its Council, the State Comptroller audits it, and the ceremony is held at the Knesset).
money_note: The prize is USD 100,000 per field, paid out of the Wolf Foundation's endowment income; the same private endowment has funded it since the first awards in 1978.
evidence_quote: Founded in 1975 with an endowment from the Wolf family, the Foundation's major donors were Dr. Ricardo Subirana Y Lobo Wolf and his wife, Francisca.
judgment_reason: A coder could call the Wolf Foundation Government, since it was created by an act of the Knesset (Wolf Foundation Law-1975), the Israeli Minister of Education chairs its Council, the State Comptroller audits it, and prizes are conferred at the Knesset. I code it Philanthropy because it is legally a private not-for-profit whose entire capital and prize money come from the Wolf family's donation, with no public appropriation.
